findings.summary: Most rows show 'less than 3 years' instead of a return, so the reader can't compare tracks on returns.
Fees appear only as percentages, and they are nearly the same across tracks. The reader wanted shekel amounts.
The page gives no next step or instructions for opening the fund.
The exposure rings use colours the reader had to guess, so a main column was unclear.
Rows are cut off between screens, so the reader didn't see some tracks in full.
The important notes under the table are in small grey text.
Many tracks look alike and have jargon names, which makes it hard to tell them apart and choose one.
